none: PAS LEIC-55B5A5: Roman copper alloy finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy finger ring fragment, 21mm long, 13mm wide and 4mm thick. The object is in fair condition and weighs 4.43grams. The object consists of a circular raised bezel which may have contained an inscription (there is the hint of a circle when viewed obliquely). This is flanked by slightly flared shoulders which appear to have scrolled edges. The ring fits Henig type VII and is similar…
